scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Iconic Mother
description:
The National Award for Senior Citizens known as Vayoshreshtha Samman was established by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment in India. 

This initiative was launched in the year 2005. 

The primary aim of the Vayoshreshtha Samman is to recognize and honor the contributions of senior citizens in various fields. 

The awards are intended to promote the welfare of older adults in India. 

The awards are presented annually on the occasion of the International Day of Older Persons which is celebrated on October 1. 

The awards are categorized into various segments to acknowledge different contributions. 

These categories include the Iconic Mother Award which specifically honors mothers who have made significant contributions to society. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman aims to create awareness about the issues faced by senior citizens. 

It also seeks to encourage the younger generation to respect and care for their elders. 

The awards are conferred based on nominations received from various stakeholders. 

These stakeholders include state governments, non-governmental organizations, and other institutions. 

The selection process involves a committee that evaluates the nominations based on specific criteria. 

The criteria for selection include the nominee's contributions to society, their achievements, and their impact on the community. 

The awards are presented by the Minister of Social Justice and Empowerment during a formal ceremony. 

The awardees receive a certificate of appreciation and a cash prize. 

The cash prize for the Vayoshreshtha Samman is ₹1,00,000. 

In addition to the cash prize, awardees also receive a shawl and a citation. 

The awards are intended to inspire other senior citizens to contribute positively to society. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman also aims to address the challenges faced by senior citizens. 

These challenges include health issues, social isolation, and financial insecurity. 

The government recognizes that senior citizens play a vital role in the family and society. 

The scheme encourages the active participation of senior citizens in various activities. 

It promotes their involvement in community service and social work. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is part of a broader framework of welfare schemes for senior citizens in India. 

Other initiatives include the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme and the National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly. 

The Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme provides a monthly pension of ₹200 for individuals aged 60-79 years. 

For those aged 80 and above, the pension amount is ₹500 per month. 

The National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly aims to provide comprehensive health care services to senior citizens. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is an important recognition that highlights the contributions of senior citizens. 

It serves as a reminder of the need for a supportive environment for older adults. 

The awards also help in raising awareness about the rights and needs of senior citizens. 

The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment has been proactive in implementing various policies for the welfare of senior citizens. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is one of the key initiatives under this umbrella. 

The awards not only honor individuals but also promote a culture of respect for elders. 

The government encourages families to take care of their elderly members. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman also aims to reduce the stigma associated with aging. 

It emphasizes the importance of valuing the experience and wisdom of senior citizens. 

The awards are a platform for showcasing the achievements of older adults. 

They serve to inspire younger generations to appreciate the contributions of their elders. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is a significant step towards creating an age-friendly society. 

The scheme is aligned with international standards and practices concerning the rights of older persons. 

The government conducts awareness campaigns to promote the Vayoshreshtha Samman. 

These campaigns aim to encourage more nominations and participation from the public. 

The awards ceremony also includes discussions and seminars on issues related to aging. 

The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment collaborates with various organizations for the successful implementation of the scheme. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman has gained recognition over the years. 

It has become a prestigious award that many aspire to receive. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to the welfare of senior citizens. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman reflects the changing perceptions of aging in Indian society. 

It highlights the need for policies that support the dignity and rights of older adults. 

The awards encourage a positive narrative around aging and senior citizens. 

The government continues to seek feedback and improve the scheme based on the needs of the elderly population. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is an essential component of India's social welfare framework. 

It plays a crucial role in promoting the well-being of senior citizens across the country. 

The scheme is a reminder of the invaluable contributions of older adults to society. 

It encourages a culture of respect and care for the elderly in families and communities. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is a significant recognition that uplifts the status of senior citizens. 

It serves as a model for similar initiatives in other countries. 

The awards are a celebration of life and the achievements of senior citizens. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman continues to evolve with changing societal norms and values. 

It aims to create a future where senior citizens are valued and respected. 

The government remains committed to enhancing the quality of life for older adults through various initiatives. 

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is an important step in this direction.
